name: audit
description: Parallel security + code review, integrated into one consolidated report.

stages.name: security
stages.task:
Threat-model and security-review the target. Return severity-ranked findings (Critical/High/Medium/Low) with file:line evidence and remediation.

{task}

stages.name: review
stages.task:
Review the target for correctness, maintainability, and style. Return findings with file:line citations and a verdict.

{task}

stages.name: report
stages.task:
Consolidate the security and code-review findings into one prioritized report: top risks first, quick wins, and a recommended remediation order. Do not invent findings not present below.
{deps}
